newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to feed military only Russian food from '97.
newsitem.headline: Russia to feed military only Russian food from '97.

text.p: Russia plans to supply its military with only home-produced food from 1997, Interfax news agency on Wednesday quoted a government decree as saying.
The government's press service could not say whether Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin had already signed the document.
Interfax said the government would spend two trillion roubles in the last quarter of 1996 on food for the military.
Imports comprise about 45 percent of Russia's total food market, and the government has in the past imported grain and other foodstuffs to feed its armed forces.
